AND CONT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT A.CONT_ID AS contId , A.SALES_ID AS salesId , A.CONT_NM AS contNm , A.CONT_AMT AS contAmt , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDt , DATE_FORMAT(A.CONT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS contDt , A.EMP_ID AS picUserId , A.CONT_STATUS AS contStatus , A.CONT_REMARK AS contRemark , B.SALES_TITLE AS salesTitle , B.EMP_ID AS salesUserId , C.EMP_NM AS picUserNm , D.EMP_NM AS salesUserNm , E.CUST_NM AS custNm , E.CUST_ID AS custId , E.CEO_NM AS ceoNm FROM TB_CONTRACT A LEFT JOIN TB_SALES B ON A.SALES_ID = B.SALES_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP C ON A.EMP_ID = C.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMP D ON B.EMP_ID = D.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER E ON B.CUST_ID = E.CUST_ID WHERE CONT_ID = #{contId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
